ev.q: This report describes the first documented case in the United States of HIV transmission
The gp41, polymerase, and p17 sequences from the donor and recipient were nearly identical, with greater than 98% identity
Recipient serum collected 12 days post transplant was reactive for HIV RNA by Aptima.
HIV DNA sequences from donor and recipient peripheral blood lymphocytes collected on day 404 were amplified and sequenced.
NYC DOHMH was notified of the possible transmission, and a public health investigation was initiated.

methods_quotes.q: HIV DNA sequences from donor and recipient peripheral blood lymphocytes collected on day 404 were amplified and sequenced.
Sequences from these two specimens were analyzed phylogenetically together with HIV sequences
